item.title: Nintendo sells 5.2 million copies of ‘Zelda’ remake in four days

item.title: Exiled Cambodian opposition leader urges Japan to aid democracy
item.description: In a recent interview in Tokyo, Rainsy criticized former Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Sen, 74, and his family for establishing a "dictatorship."

item.title: Japan, eight others get fossil award over leaders skipping climate talks
item.description: From the Group of Seven countries, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham is the only leader expected to attend the summit.

item.title: Japan top court rules 2025 election in unconstitutional state
item.description: Chief Justice Yukihiko Imasaki said the maximum vote-value disparity raised constitutional concerns but dismissed requests to invalidate the election.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
